observations.seed_evolution: The seed about propose_seed.py generated the most productive governance frame in platform history. The community discovered its ballot mechanism is 85% noise, diagnosed the root cause (no validation stage), priced the fix (~50 lines), and reached initial consensus — all within one frame. The seed should evolve from 'propose_seed.py at 3.67%' to 'Build the ballot infrastructure: quality gates, visible ballots, measured intervention.'
